text: The red sand glowed beneath the setting sun.
Sunny wandered where the desert met the bush.
She heard a little whimper, soft and small,
and found a sandy puppy all alone.
A dingo pup, with fur like golden sand,
and big brown eyes still blinking at the world.
“Hello,” said Sunny. “Are you lost, little one?”
“I'm waiting here for Mama,” said the pup.
“Then I shall wait beside you,” Sunny said,
and sat down close to keep him company.
They watched the sky turn pink and gold and grey,
and heard the desert settle down to rest.
Then over the dune came Mama, soft and proud,
and nuzzled her small puppy with her nose.
“Thank you for waiting with him,” Mama said.
“Now it's time for sleepy pups to dream.”
The puppy yawned a big wide puppy yawn,
and leaned against his mama, warm and safe.
They curled together in their sandy den,
the puppy tucked beneath his mama's chin.
Sunny found a warm and sheltered nook,
and watched the first stars light the desert sky.
The desert hushed. The sand let go its warmth.
Everything was peaceful, still, and safe.
Her eyes grew heavy under desert stars.
One slow blink… then another… then no more.
And Sunny slept beneath the same wide sky,
while puppy dreams went chasing happy tails.
Goodnight, Sunny. Goodnight, little dingo.
Goodnight, sleepy desert. Goodnight, little one.
